name: redis
description: Work with Redis data, caching, and search through the official Redis MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage and search Redis data: structures, caching, query engine, vectors.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to the official Redis MCP server (redis-mcp-server, from the redis/mcp-redis project) against your own Redis instance, local or cloud. Inspect and manipulate strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, and streams; design cache layers with sound invalidation and stampede protection; and build full-text, JSON, and vector search with the Redis Query Engine. Connection details stay in environment variables, never in config.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Redis keyspace and summarize what is stored and how much memory it uses
Design a cache-aside layer with stampede protection for {endpoint}
Create a Redis vector index for {collection} and run a semantic search
